realistic_minigames.name: Change a Flat in the Dark
realistic_minigames.how: Drag tools on a close-up of the wheel; hold the flashlight steady with the other hand (mouse button or second finger).
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Wedge the wheel opposite the flat. 2. Loosen lug nuts a half turn while the tire is on the ground. 3. Jack at the frame point. 4. Remove nuts, swap the tire. 5. Hand-tighten, lower, then tighten in a star pattern.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Jacking before loosening: the wheel spins (time, noise). Wrong jack point: the car drops (injury). Dropped lug nut: search the snow (noise).
realistic_minigames.data: Cold hands (NOAA normal); noise meter (local infection).
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY 120 s, checklist | NORMAL 90 s | HARD 70 s, one lug nut is seized
realistic_minigames.win_text: Keep your vehicle; no time lost
realistic_minigames.fail_text: Vehicle lost OR 3 h delay; -10 health if the car drops

fail.reason: the car slipped off the jack

realistic_minigames.name: Jump-Start a Dead Battery
realistic_minigames.how: Drag cable clamps onto battery terminals, then hold to crank and watch the dash lights.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Red clamp on the dead battery (+). 2. Red on the good battery (+). 3. Black on the good battery (-). 4. Black on bare metal away from the dead battery. 5. Run the good car, then crank. Remove in reverse order.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Wrong order or touching clamps: sparks (injury -8, big noise). Cranking too long: battery drains, start over.
realistic_minigames.data: Cold hands; cold batteries need more cranking attempts below 20°F (NOAA normal).
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY labeled terminals | NORMAL unlabeled | HARD dirty terminals to scrape first
realistic_minigames.fail_text: Stranded: plays the On Foot fallback

realistic_minigames.name: Treat a Wound
realistic_minigames.how: Open a first-aid kit and drag items onto the wound; hold pressure with a press-and-hold gauge.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Gloves. 2. Firm direct pressure until bleeding slows (hold the gauge in the green). 3. Rinse with clean water. 4. Look closely: bite marks or not. 5. Bandage and note the time.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Too little pressure: bleeding continues (-5 health per 10 s). Alcohol in a deep wound: stings (noise). Skip the look: a bite stays hidden.
realistic_minigames.data: Infection system: a correct check tells you whether you were bitten, so treatment can start before symptoms (rabies-style rule).
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY 90 s, kit labeled | NORMAL 60 s | HARD 45 s, two wounds
realistic_minigames.win_text: +10 health; learn your true infection status

realistic_minigames.name: Cold Emergency Triage
realistic_minigames.how: Check a shivering companion (tap to inspect speech, skin, fingers), then drag actions into order.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Out of the wind. 2. Remove wet clothes. 3. Dry layers and a sleeping bag. 4. Warm sweet drink if alert. 5. Frostbite: rewarm in warm, not hot, water; don't rub.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Rubbing frostbite or using hot water: tissue damage (-10 health). Skipping wet clothes: condition worsens on the timer.
realistic_minigames.data: Difficulty (how fast the companion worsens) uses the stop's real NOAA January normal.
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY 120 s, signs labeled | NORMAL 90 s | HARD 60 s, companion also has frostbite

realistic_minigames.name: Make Water Safe
realistic_minigames.how: Pick a water source, pour it through a cloth filter, light the stove, and stop the boil timer at the right moment (or count bleach drops from the label chart).
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Choose the clearest source. 2. Filter through cloth. 3. Rolling boil 1 minute, or 3 minutes above 6,500 ft (CDC guidance). 4. Cool and store covered.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Boil too short: sick later (-15 health over 12 h). Boil far too long: stove fuel wasted (-1 gal fuel). Wrong source: worse odds.
realistic_minigames.data: Elevation from the real NOAA station: Laramie (about 7,270 ft), Rock Springs (about 6,740 ft), Dillon (about 9,070 ft) need the longer boil.
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY elevation shown | NORMAL you must check the map | HARD the stove sputters

realistic_minigames.name: Siphon Fuel
realistic_minigames.how: Feed a hose into the tank, squeeze a pump bulb in rhythm, and keep the gas can below the tank.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Hose past the anti-rollover valve (wiggle to feel it). 2. Can on the ground, below the tank. 3. Pump the bulb until flow starts. 4. Stop before the can overflows.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Can held above the tank: no flow. Over-pumping: spill (fire risk, injury -8, noise). Forcing the hose: it jams.
realistic_minigames.data: Noise meter uses local infection; cold hands slow the pump rhythm.
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY 90 s | NORMAL 70 s | HARD 50 s, tank half empty
realistic_minigames.win_text: +5 to +10 gal fuel (by how well you did)

realistic_minigames.name: Put On Tire Chains
realistic_minigames.how: Drape a chain over the tire, connect hooks on the inside then the outside, then tighten and drive a few feet to recheck.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Lay the chain flat, no twists. 2. Drape over the tire. 3. Hook the inside first. 4. Hook the outside. 5. Tighten, drive 10 ft, retighten.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Twisted chain or loose hooks: it snaps on the climb (injury -10, time). Skipping the recheck: loosens halfway.
realistic_minigames.data: Cold hands; plays on the snowy mountain stops (NOAA snowfall).
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY 120 s | NORMAL 90 s | HARD 60 s, both tires
realistic_minigames.fail_text: Slide on the grade: -15 health or a 3 h delay

realistic_minigames.name: Navigate by Map and Compass
realistic_minigames.how: A paper road map of the real counties on your route. Rotate the compass, read a bearing, and trace a detour while watching the odometer.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Orient the map to north. 2. Mark where you are. 3. Pick roads that avoid the closure. 4. Follow the bearing; check landmarks every few miles.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Wrong bearing: extra miles and fuel. Ignoring landmarks: a dead end.
realistic_minigames.data: Real county names and road distances (OpenStreetMap/OSRM) on the map.
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY landmarks marked | NORMAL some marked | HARD night, flashlight only

realistic_minigames.name: Find the Emergency Broadcast
realistic_minigames.how: Turn a radio dial through static, fine-tune by ear (the signal clears as you get close), and type the key facts you hear.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Scan the NOAA Weather Radio band (162.400-162.550 MHz). 2. Fine-tune until the static clears. 3. Note closures, safe-zone hours, and the weather.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Moving too fast: you miss the message. Wrong notes: you act on bad info.
realistic_minigames.data: Real NOAA Weather Radio frequencies; the message names real towns and road closures on your route.
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY strong signal | NORMAL weak signal | HARD signal drifts
realistic_minigames.win_text: Route info: a shortcut or warning (acts like an ally flag)

realistic_minigames.name: Snowed In: Carbon Monoxide
realistic_minigames.how: Your car is buried. Dig around the car, check the tailpipe, crack a window, then run the heater on a timer.
realistic_minigames.steps: 1. Clear the tailpipe completely. 2. Crack a window on the downwind side. 3. Run the engine about 10 minutes an hour. 4. Stay awake for the timer.
realistic_minigames.mistakes: Running the engine with a blocked tailpipe: the screen blurs and health drains until you fix it. Never running it: cold damage.
realistic_minigames.data: Snow depth uses the stop's real NOAA January snowfall.
realistic_minigames.tiers: EASY reminders shown | NORMAL none | HARD fuel low, so every minute of heat costs fuel

minigame_rules: Every fumble, dropped tool, wrong step or spark adds noise. When the meter fills, the infected arrive and the game ends early (counts as a fail).

How fast infected arrive scales with the local infectious share from the SEIR curve: arrival time = base time / (1 + 10 x infectious share) (fictional rule). Manhattan on Day 4 is far less forgiving than Teton County.
Drag and hold actions lag and shake more in the cold.
Control lag = 1 + 0.02 x degrees below 32°F, using the stop's real NOAA January normal (fictional rule on real data).
Each game has a real-world correct order. Steps done out of order trigger the consequence listed for that game.
Procedures follow standard guidance (tire changing, jump-starting, first aid, cold injuries, water safety, carbon monoxide).
EASY shows a checklist and a long timer; NORMAL hides the checklist; HARD hides it, shortens the timer and adds a second problem.
Same HARD/NORMAL/EASY roll rules as the original eight games.
A mini game does not repeat in one playthrough. Story-linked games play when their scene calls for them; any not yet played join the random roll pool.
The original eight games stay in the roll pool, so 18 games in total.
